svg.aria-label: All fractals have the size of the power set of the naturals
svg.title: All fractals have the size of the power set of the naturals

g.text: At infinity every fractal has the same number of points
the naturals, the rationals: countable sets (dimension 0)
The gap where a half power set of ℕ would have to live.
Open without the axiom of choice (earlier page). No fractal can sit here:
every closed set is countable or holds a full Cantor set (Cantor–Bendixson).
all = P(ℕ) as sets: a point is a left/right path, a path is a subset of ℕ
Dimension measures how spread out the points are, not how many there are.
